title: Features gone or beyond expectations
summary: This topic combines scattered mentions of removed features, depleted charge, and expectations being exceeded, with most fragments too incomplete to determine a clear sentiment about the vehicle.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention the vehicle or service going beyond expectations and leaving the reviewer happy.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include incomplete references to missing functions, logos, compartments, charge state, alarms, tutorials, and broader expectation statements that lack enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as charge depletion, removed features, brand logo changes, service comments, tutorials, and purchase context.
Most fragments are short or incomplete, so sentiment and the exact aspect being discussed are often unclear.
The examples are insufficient to separate vehicle-related feedback from service-related feedback in every case.
